chart.title: Cropland per person over the long-term
chart.subtitle: Total cropland per capita, measured in hectares per person.

Land use (per capita): Cropland.descriptionShort: Total cropland area for per person each separate country over time.
Land use (per capita): Cropland.descriptionKey:
- 'Cropland' here is equivalent to the FAO category of 'arable land and permanent crops'.
- The order of allocation is as follows: first, we allocate cropland, then rice, then irrigation and finally grazing land.
